sensitivePaths.label: Run SQL on a project
sensitivePaths.warning: A query can change or drop data.

agentGuide: Management API, base path /v1 (the account, not one database). Organizations: GET /v1/organizations; projects: GET /v1/projects (id = ref, name, region, status); one: GET /v1/projects/<ref>. Database: run SQL with POST /v1/projects/<ref>/database/query {"query": "select ..."} (rows as JSON; writes too, so read before you write); tables: query information_schema. API keys of a project: GET /v1/projects/<ref>/api-keys (anon and service_role: secrets, do not repeat them). Functions: GET /v1/projects/<ref>/functions; secrets names: GET /v1/projects/<ref>/secrets. Pause or restore: POST /v1/projects/<ref>/pause (restore). Usage and health: GET /v1/projects/<ref>/health?services=db,rest. The token is set by Allkin.
